What better way to end Earth Week than with some #GoodClimateNews?

Read more: goodclimatenews.substack.com/p/edition-41...
Happy #EarthDay y’all 🫶
Are you going to pay for the income I would lose by deleting those platforms? I don't think so because Instagram is my main platform, and paid partnerships I post there account for 80% of my income.

We’ve still got to take action to prevent further damage from his administration, but isn’t it wild that he’s helping other countries commit more to climate action? 

(Folks on Facebook are already sending me threats because of this video, so that means I must be doing something right!)
In a first last month, renewables supplied more power to the U.S. than natural gas, a milestone in the shift to clean energy.

It’s #EarthMonth, and I promise you there’s still hope for a better future!

Read more: goodclimatenews.substack.com/p/edition-40...
It's wild that this is the only platform that enjoyed this video, but good to know that y'all enjoy nature-based solutions because I do as well!
Sea otters are both adorable and critical to coastal ecosystems!
As someone who lives in a region with thousands of abandoned coal mines, this is fantastic news!

Good morning with good news: First turbine is installed at the 924 MW Sunrise Wind New York offshore wind farm!

Sunrise Wind will generate first power in 2026 and be fully operational in 2027. It has 84 11-MW turbines.

Sunrise Wind wins. Trump lost!
www.offshorewind.biz/2026/03/31/f... #energysky

Shoutout to Rice University for their researchers bringing us one step closer to addressing #PFAS pollution!

Review the research here: doi.org/10.1002/adma...

I think so! If I fly, I have no choice but to leave from a tiny airport and fly into a hub. Those flights never last more than 45 min, so they could easily be electric in the future!

(Obviously I want more public transit too and would take that over flying if it was available in my area)

UK's Renewables Output Hits Record, Helping to Blunt Iran Shock.

Solar generation reached roughly 10 GW, just below a record set in July last year, while wind output climbed to almost 24 GWs, a new high." 

Oil/gas again prove they endanger economies.
www.bloomberg.com/news/article...
#energysky

If you constantly negatively respond to my content, you will be blocked moving forward.

The endless unconstructive criticism of my work is destroying my mental health and making me not want to produce content anymore.

So please be kind or else I’m going to have to find another job.
I don't know about y'all, but I love watching climate solutions go from being theorized to being commercially viable.

If you’re telling people not to attend protests yet aren’t offering alternatives for action, you’re part of the problem!

We shouldn’t be discouraging action at a time like this — especially when protests are crucial to building coalition in conservative and rural areas.

Is there a term for being envious of other countries expanding and modernizing their passenger rail infrastructure??

Because whatever it is, I have it as an American who lives just a few blocks away from an old passenger rail station that is now a burger restaurant..

Don’t want more data centers?

Join me in demanding that Congress pass a national moratorium on data centers at the link in the replies.

Our communities and our planet deserve better.

If you don’t want to be a paid subscriber to Good Climate News anymore, that’s fine. 

Please cancel your subscription on Substack instead of disputing the charge with your bank because I have to pay back all the money you’ve ever spent on that subscription if you do that!
What better way to end Earth Week than with some #GoodClimateNews?

New and existing customers can use my code ALAINA25 for 25% off orders over $75 at the link in bio. #GrovePartner #SustainableLiving #CleaningTips
